concept.title: Diwali prep co-ord
concept.hook: Dont want to spend a bomb on diwali? I have got you covered
concept.voiceoverScript: Don't want to spend a bomb on Diwali? I have got you covered. Pehla look, yeh fully stitched co-ord set. Fabric slub cotton hai, dekho yeh texture. Soft aur breathable, full sleeves bhi, toh rangoli banate time bhi easy. Fit regular aur comfy hai, din bhar wahi chalega. Shaam ko jhumke add karo, festive ready.

scenes.visualPrompt: Bright living room on Diwali morning, a half-finished colourful rangoli on the floor near the doorway, marigold garlands on the door frame, soft natural daylight through sheer curtains. Vertical medium-full shot, cheerful busy mood. She wears the co-ord set: a full-sleeve top with matching pants in soft slub cotton with a visibly slubbed textured weave, colour and design as shown in the reference. She walks into frame holding a small bowl of rangoli powder, stops, looks straight into camera with a knowing, reassuring grin as she speaks, then gestures down at the outfit with her free hand.
scenes.dialogue: Don't want to spend a bomb on Diwali? I have got you covered. Pehla look, yeh fully stitched co-ord set.

concept.caption: My Diwali prep uniform 🌼 KOHINOOR co-ord by Titli India: premium slub cotton, soft and breathable, full sleeves, fully stitched, regular comfy fit. Add jhumkas by evening and you're set.
concept.musicMood: Bright, breezy morning acoustic with light festive percussion

flow.characterPrompt:
CHARACTER REFERENCE (use the attached image as the exact likeness):
A young Indian woman in her mid-twenties with long dark brown hair, loosely waved and falling past her shoulders, parted slightly off-centre. Warm medium skin tone, dark brown almond-shaped eyes, full defined eyebrows, high cheekbones, a softly rounded jaw and a natural warm smile. Slim build, average height.

VOICE: Warm, bright young female voice with a natural Indian English accent, medium pitch, clear unforced pronunciation, conversational rather than presentational. Speaks natural Hinglish, switching easily between Hindi and English. Sounds like a friend talking to camera, not a voice-over. Lively pitch variation, genuine enthusiasm, natural pauses. Never flat, never salesy.
She should always be speaking in hinglish that is mix of english and hindi

This is a fully AI-generated fictional character. No real person, celebrity or
public figure is depicted, referenced or named. Keep her face, hair, skin tone
and marks identical in every shot.
